page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; no margin notes on the printed page (the strip at the left edge is the neighbouring page and is excluded); page number at the head; catchword "atque" at the lower right.

main_text.p: pturæ s. lectione auditores suos vi & fraude quovis modo arcent, atq; illius loco imagines, tanquam idiotarum libros, in templis collocant; lignum, eruditionem vanitatum, teste Jerem. cap. 10. 8. simulacrum, doctorem mendacii, teste Habac. cap. 2. 18.

Et, ne quis eorum placitis contradicere audeat, spretâ Christi auctoritate, supremam in universâ ecclesiâ pontifici suo potestatem in ecclesiasticis & politicis causis tribuunt: Imò tantam, ut etiam contra apostolum, Christum ipsum & spiritum s. dispensare queat. Exempli gratia, ut sibi quis incestis nuptiis conjungat uxorem fratris sui, (sicuti Henricus VIII. rex Angliæ Catharinâ) aut sororis filiam (sicuti Philippus II. rex Hispaniæ Annam) contra difertum Dei interdictum Levit. 18. 12. 16. & 20. 21. de quo argumento prolixius item disseruimus in Medul-la papismi pag. 193. 194. et sequent. 331. et sequentibus. Si qui verò ex edicto apostoli Colos. 3. pio studio recondendi verbum Christi tenentur, atque

page.notes: Left margin strip shows the edge of the facing page and is not transcribed. Faint pencil-like marks at the lower left beside the catchword are not legible and are not transcribed as a signature. Italic spans are approximate where the scan is faint. "difertum" and "Ierem" read as printed; the word after "contra di-" is the line-break split of "difertum".
